sources.title: Get an electronic travel authorisation (ETA) to visit the UK
facts: An ETA costs £20
It costs £20 to apply online or through the UK ETA app. You cannot get a refund after you apply.
An ETA lasts for 2 years or until your passport expires, whichever is sooner.
You’ll usually get a decision by email within a day, but it can take up to 3 working days.
Each person travelling needs an ETA, including babies and children.
Other websites may charge more to apply. Avoid websites that imitate government services.

sources.title: Electronic Travel Authority (subclass 601) — Department of Home Affairs
facts: There is a service charge of AUD20 to use the Australian ETA app. There is no other charge payable for an ETA.
valid for travel to Australia for either 12 months, or for the period your passport is valid, whichever is shorter
You can remain in Australia for 3 months after each entry.
Each family member … must submit a separate application.
European passport holders may be eligible for an eVisitor (subclass 651) visa. There is no charge to make an eVisitor visa application.

facts: The eVisitor visa is valid for travel to Australia for 12 months, starting from the date it is granted.
You can stay in Australia for 3 months after each entry.
